title: Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation Improves Small Pointwise LLM Judges
title_zh: 反事实成对增强提升小型逐点式LLM裁判

paragraphs.en: 提出反事实成对增强方法CPA，通过联合训练提升小型逐点式LLM裁判的评分准确率。 Agentic systems increasingly gate individual steps with a pointwise judge that scores a response against a criterion. Small language models are attractive for this role because they can be served and specialized efficiently. Such a judge must locate the criterion's decision boundary, but pointwise labels under-determine that boundary in fine-tuning: labeled responses to different queries differ along many dimensions at once, so they do not reveal which features decide the label. We introduce CPA (Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation), which makes the deciding difference explicit in training. For each pointwise item, CPA synthesizes and audits a counterfactual response to the same query intended to carry the opposite label. It frames the accepted pair as a pairwise task asking which of the two responses satisfies the criterion. The judge is fine-tuned jointly on both pointwise and pairwise datasets and deployed in pointwise mode only. A second-order analysis shows when this should outperform the prevailing strategy of merging separately trained pointwise and pairwise experts: merging moves every parameter direction toward the pairwise expert by the same fraction, whereas joint training can hold the pointwise optimum wherever the pairwise loss is flat and absorb its curvature where it is sharp. This is the regime that CPA's same-source, counterfactually minimal pairwise view is designed to produce. On separate Qwen3-8B LoRA adapters for six binary criteria, CPA improves criterion-averaged pointwise macro-F1 by 2.5 points over pointwise-only training and outperforms model merging on all six criteria at every tested merge weight. It also surpasses the strongest zero-shot frontier judge we evaluate, Gemini 3.6 Flash, by 11.8 points.
paragraphs.zh: 提出反事实成对增强方法CPA，通过联合训练提升小型逐点式LLM裁判的评分准确率。智能体系统日益依赖逐点式裁判为单个步骤把关，即依据某个准则对响应进行评分。 小型语言模型很适合担任这一角色，因为它们可以被高效地部署和特化。 这样的裁判必须定位准则的决策边界，但在微调中逐点标签无法充分确定该边界：对不同查询的带标签响应在多个维度上同时存在差异，因此无法揭示哪些特征决定了标签。 我们提出CPA（Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation，反事实成对增强），使决定性差异在训练中变得显式。 对于每个逐点式样本，CPA为同一查询合成并审核一个旨在携带相反标签的反事实响应。 它将所接受的响应对表述为一个成对任务，即询问两个响应中哪一个满足该准则。 该裁判同时在逐点式和成对式数据集上进行联合微调，但仅以逐点式模式部署。 二阶分析表明，这种方法应优于当前主流的将分别训练的逐点式与成对式专家模型进行合并的策略：合并会将每个参数方向按相同比例向成对式专家移动，而联合训练可以在成对损失平坦之处保持逐点式最优解不变，并在其陡峭之处吸收其曲率。 这正是CPA的同源、反事实最小化的成对视图旨在产生的情形。 在针对六个二元准则的独立Qwen3-8B LoRA适配器上，CPA将准则平均的逐点式宏F1较仅逐点式训练提升了2.5分，并在所有测试的合并权重下于全部六个准则上均优于模型合并。 它还以11.8分的优势超越了我们评估的最强零样本前沿裁判Gemini 3.6 Flash。
